# SHOP.md

> An open standard for AI-readable store context. A structured markdown file at /shop.md gives any AI agent the context it needs to qualify, evaluate, and recommend a commerce store.

## Spec

- [SHOP.md](https://shopmd.org/spec/shop-md/): Store context layer, full field reference
- [CATALOG.md](https://shopmd.org/spec/catalog-md/): Queryable product catalogue endpoint standard
- [POLICIES.md](https://shopmd.org/spec/policies-md/): Store policy standard (shipping, returns, warranty)
- [BRAND.md](https://shopmd.org/spec/brand-md/): Brand identity and voice standard (concept by Caio Pizzol, thebrand.md)

## Validation

- [Validation](https://shopmd.org/implement/validate/): Hosted validator API and CLI for checking SHOP.md/CATALOG.md/POLICIES.md/BRAND.md files against the spec

## Getting started

- [Getting Started](https://shopmd.org/getting-started/): Minimum viable implementation, headers, robots.txt
- [Contributing](https://shopmd.org/contributing/): Change process and versioning policy

## Examples

- [Acme Pet Supply](https://shopmd.org/examples/acme-pet/)
- [Nova Fashion](https://shopmd.org/examples/nova-fashion/)
- [Fold Electronics](https://shopmd.org/examples/fold-electronics/)
